meta_tools.name: codespar_account
meta_tools.description: What the person's CodeSpar Test project holds, read-only: `balance` (the project's account balance per currency; no account yet is not a zero balance), `mandates` (the spending mandates' limits and status) or `proposals` (the latest payment proposals, newest first, payee masked, with the receipt id once paid). Only on the integrated Test; elsewhere it answers `available: false` and reads nothing. It cannot pay, approve or change anything.

local_tools.name: list_bills
local_tools.description: The bills of the current month: payee alias, name, amount in BRL cents, due date and days until it falls due (negative once past), plus `today`, the only date you know. Read-only.
